name: Cheek Texture
description: Analyzes cheek skin 文本ure patterns
algorithm: Cheek Texture — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes cheek skin texture patterns across video frames for deepfake detection:

1. **Cheek区域提取**: Using facial landmarks, the cheek regions (below the zygomatic bone, lateral to the nose, above the jawline) are precisely segmented per frame. The regions are geometrically normalized to compensate for head pose variations, enabling consistent texture comparison across frames.

2. **Micro-纹理分析**: High-frequency texture features — pores, fine wrinkles, skin grain, and sebaceous patterns — are extracted using Gabor filters and Local Binary Pattern (LBP) descriptors. Real human cheek skin exhibits a characteristic multi-scale texture hierarchy determined by dermatological structure.

3. **纹理时间一致性**: The micro-texture signature of cheek regions is tracked across consecutive frames. In authentic video, skin micro-texture remains stable (pores don't move or disappear between frames). Deepfake generators often produce inconsistent frame-to-frame micro-texture — pores may appear, disappear, or shift position as the generator independently synthesizes each frame.

4. **皮肤RenderingQuality评估**: The statistical properties of cheek texture (histogram of oriented gradients, spatial frequency distribution) are compared against natural skin models. AI-generated cheeks tend to be either over-smoothed (lacking natural pore detail) or show artificial texture patterns with repetitive structures uncommon in real skin.

5. **光照-Independent纹理评分**: Texture features are computed in illumination-invariant color spaces to separate genuine texture from illumination effects. The final score quantifies the deviation of cheek texture from expected natural skin characteristics and its temporal stability across frames.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through cheek 文本ure analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频
